integrity_note: The deterministic walk kernel and local Weyl law are credited to prior primary sources. Stochastic endpoint and coefficient are assessed only as a self-review; no independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Compact finite connected metric graph, positive edge lengths, scalar Kirchhoff Laplacian and additive flux Brownian noise only.
No claim for noise in continuity conditions, nonlinear dynamics, edge-interior noise, time-dependent covariances or noncompact graphs.
Almost-sure regularity is for each fixed positive time; subcritical sample-path continuity is not asserted.
Deterministic heat-kernel local Weyl laws and Gaussian zero-one/Fernique theorems are established input results.
title: Degree-weighted critical regularity for Kirchhoff vertex noise on metric graphs
